title: Yellowmoon camera registry
description: data/cameras/registry.json, generated by training/sensor_map/build_registry.py from the table in docs/03. Lookup: exact model ID -> sensor family -> default. A model ID that is not in 'bodies' gets 'default_profile' with match 'default'. Also required (checked by training/sensor_map/validate_profiles.py): model IDs and model strings unique, every profile id has a profile file, every profile has exactly one 'exact' body, 'via' names the profile's measured body for 'sensor_family' and is null otherwise, every 'default' body uses default_profile, model_strings agree with bodies.

default_profile.description: Profile for every Sony body without an entry (the A7R IV stand-in).

profiles.description: Profile ids and their files, relative to data/cameras/.

model.description: IFD0 Model string, as ExifTool names the ID.

body.description: Display name, for example 'Sony A7R IV'.

via.description: For sensor_family: display name of the profile's measured body. Null otherwise.

model_strings.description: Model string -> model ID, for files whose maker note has no usable 0xB001 (docs/03: when they disagree the model ID wins).
